TemplateBody:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: DynamoDB tables required by PlatformSocialPostAPI.

Parameters:
  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Default: PAY_PER_REQUEST
    AllowedValues:
      - PAY_PER_REQUEST

Resources:
  SocialConnectionTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: SocialConnection
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: SocialConnectionID
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: OrganizationID
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: Platform
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: ExternalAccountID
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: Status
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: SocialConnectionID
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: OrganizationID-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: OrganizationID
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
        - IndexName: Platform-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: Platform
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
        - IndexName: ExternalAccountID-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: ExternalAccountID
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
        - IndexName: Status-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: Status
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL

  SocialConnectionTokenTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: SocialConnectionToken
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: TokenSecretID
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: SocialConnectionID
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: OrganizationID
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: Platform
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: TokenSecretID
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: SocialConnectionID-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: SocialConnectionID
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
        - IndexName: OrganizationID-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: OrganizationID
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
        - IndexName: Platform-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: Platform
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL

  SocialPostTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: SocialPost
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: SocialPostID
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: OrganizationID
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: ResourceType
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: ResourceID
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: OutreachItemID
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: Status
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: SocialPostID
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: OrganizationID-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: OrganizationID
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
        - IndexName: ResourceType-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: ResourceType
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
        - IndexName: ResourceID-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: ResourceID
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
        - IndexName: OutreachItemID-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: OutreachItemID
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
        - IndexName: Status-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: Status
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL

  SocialPostDeliveryTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: SocialPostDelivery
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: DeliveryID
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: SocialPostID
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: OrganizationID
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: SocialConnectionID
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: Platform
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: Status
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: DeliveryID
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: SocialPostID-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: SocialPostID
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
        - IndexName: OrganizationID-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: OrganizationID
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
        - IndexName: SocialConnectionID-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: SocialConnectionID
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
        - IndexName: Platform-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: Platform
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
        - IndexName: Status-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: Status
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL

  SocialPostClickTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: SocialPostClick
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: ClickID
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: SocialPostID
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: ClickID
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: SocialPostID-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: SocialPostID
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL

Outputs:
  SocialConnectionTableName:
    Value: !Ref SocialConnectionTable
  SocialConnectionTokenTableName:
    Value: !Ref SocialConnectionTokenTable
  SocialPostTableName:
    Value: !Ref SocialPostTable
  SocialPostDeliveryTableName:
    Value: !Ref SocialPostDeliveryTable
